lineage.description: Educational facility locations and attributes were collected through open and participatory methods by the Open Cities Project in partnership with local stakeholders in the Kathmandu Valley. The dataset provides spatial inventory of schools and educational infrastructure assets for disaster risk assessment in an earthquake-prone region.
